summary: Full v2.1 verification (backend + frontend). 30/30 pytest passing (10 new v2.1 tests + 20 regression). Frontend visually verified: CoolingFX snowflakes/wind animations, shimmer 'Premium Quality' text, 4-card stats strip, animate-ticker scrolling deals, 100% Satisfaction Guarantee banner, 'Real Reviews from Real Homes' with 3 testimonial cards (Ayesha/Bilal/Hira), dark Founder Quote section, SOLD OUT badge with grayscale image + 'Currently Sold Out' disabled button on ProductCard AND ProductDetailPage (Add to Cart / Order Now correctly hidden, 'Out of Stock — More coming soon!' notice shown), Admin 'Site Content' tab with all 10 setting groups and working 'Save All Changes' → green 'Saved — changes are live' toast. Backend: GET /api/site-settings returns all 33+ keys, PUT /admin/site-settings whitelists keys (malicious_key_xyz silently dropped), admin review with custom created_at='2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z' persists exactly, /api/orders/link-guest auth-required and claims unowned orders idempotently, guest order POST with registered email auto-links user_email so it appears in /api/orders/my, stock=0 product still returned by public GET /api/products. ONE FRONTEND BUG FOUND: Admin Review form is missing the <input type='datetime-local'> field — state and conversion logic exist but the input element is not rendered, so admin cannot override review date from UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing <input type='datetime-local'> for review created_at override. State (reviewForm.created_at), pre-fill conversion (lines 218-229), and ISO conversion on save (lines 259-266) are all wired up correctly, but the actual datetime-local input element is NOT rendered in the form JSX (around lines 957-995). Admin cannot override review date/time from UI even though backend API supports it (verified via pytest).

action_items: Add a <input type='datetime-local'> field to the Admin Review form in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx (between the Comment textarea ~line 963 and the Review Images section ~line 965, or above the verified_purchase/is_approved checkboxes). Label 'Review Date & Time (optional override)'. Bind to reviewForm.created_at via setReviewForm. Wiring on save already exists.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend whitelist filter in PUT /api/admin/site-settings (server.py L809-811) is correctly preventing arbitrary key injection — verified malicious_key_xyz silently dropped.

/api/orders/link-guest query (server.py L654-658) correctly restricts claim to orders where user_email is None/missing OR already-equal-user-email — prevents stealing another user's order by knowing order_number. Test was initially using a non-matching guest email which made link-guest correctly return 0; using anonymous order (no email) passes.
Auto-link by email at order create (server.py L626-632) looks up registered users by email and sets user_email so the order appears in /api/orders/my immediately on next login — verified working.
Admin review create_at override + idempotent /admin/reviews PUT working — admin can set custom date on create AND update.

SOLD OUT visual treatment is well-implemented: grayscale + opacity-80 on the image, rotated red 'SOLD OUT' badge overlay, 'Currently Sold Out' disabled button replaces all actions. ProductDetailPage hides Add to Cart and Order Now entirely (cleaner UX than disabling).
Two console 401s on /api/auth/me on initial load (unauthenticated) still present — cosmetic, not blocking.

rca_of_issue: Missing UI element bug RCA: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx, the reviewForm state initialization includes created_at: '' (L35), the handleEditReview function pre-populates reviewForm.created_at by converting the existing review's ISO timestamp to datetime-local format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (L218-229), and handleSaveReview converts the datetime-local string back to ISO before posting (L259-266). However, the form JSX (review modal at the bottom of the file) renders product selector, reviewer name, rating, comment textarea, image upload, verified_purchase checkbox, and is_approved checkbox — but never renders the <input type='datetime-local' /> bound to reviewForm.created_at. Fix: add 6-8 lines of JSX with a label 'Review Date & Time (optional override)' and an <input type='datetime-local' value={reviewForm.created_at} onChange={e => setReviewForm(p => ({...p, created_at: e.target.value}))} data-testid='admin-review-date' /> between the comment field and the images field.
